package cli

import (
	fb "github.com/Barben360/backsight/internal/feedback"
)

// Each function reads ledger.json, or names it, as only the fallback may.
func loadsTheLedger() { _, _ = fb.LoadLedger("d") }

func current() { _, _ = fb.Current("d") }

func rebuilds() { _, _ = fb.Rebuild("d") }

func buildsAReader() { _ = fb.CurrentReader{Dir: "d"} }

func namesTheFile() string { return "ledger.json" }

var inAClosure = func() { _, _ = fb.LoadLedger("d") }

type other struct{}

func (other) indexLedger() { _ = &fb.CurrentReader{} }

func (w *Writer) Export() { _, _ = fb.LoadLedger("d") }

func ledgerReader() { _ = fb.CurrentReader{} }

func bare() { _, _ = LoadLedger("d") }

var f = fb.LoadLedger

func passesIt() { apply(fb.Current) }

func allocates() { _ = new(fb.CurrentReader) }

var r fb.CurrentReader

func typed(c fb.CurrentReader) { _ = c.Current; _ = other{}.Current() }
